crossRefs.note: Or don’t you know that all we who were baptized into Christ Jesus were baptized into his death?
For I could wish that I myself were accursed from Christ for my brothers’ sake, my relatives according to the flesh
Brothers, my heart’s desire and my prayer to God is for Israel, that they may be saved.
Indeed you bear the name of a Jew, rest on the law, glory in God,
know his will, and approve the things that are excellent, being instructed out of the law,
You, Ezra, according to the wisdom of your God that is in your hand, appoint magistrates and judges, who may judge all…
For the commandment is a lamp, and the law is light. Reproofs of instruction are the way of life,
Do I speak these things according to the ways of men? Or doesn’t the law also say the same thing?
Tell me, you that desire to be under the law, don’t you listen to the law?
But now we have been discharged from the law, having died to that in which we were held; so that we serve in newness of…
For sin will not have dominion over you. For you are not under law, but under grace.

translations.web: Or don’t you know, brothers (for I speak to men who know the law), that the law has dominion over a man for as long as he lives?
translations.bsb: Do you not know, brothers (for I am speaking to those who know the law), that the law has authority over a man only as long as he lives?
translations.kjv: Know ye not, brethren, (for I speak to them that know the law,) how that the law hath dominion over a man as long as he liveth?
translations.asv: Or are ye ignorant, brethren (for I speak to men who know the law), that the law hath dominion over a man for so long time as he liveth?
